events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.

One moment while I check your details.
Your question has been sent to the prescribing team, and the reference is Q N, two seven six eight. A clinician will answer, and your prescription record has not been changed.
Okay, then please pass it on to a doctor.
It has already been passed to the Cedar Clinic prescribing team. Your reference is Q N, two seven six eight.
